headline: Austin’s week of loud nights, illegal fireworks, and neglected streets

items.text: Rainey house is louder than usual which is already usually really bad. Idk who has a new subwoofer or bass system but I can’t drown out the music OR bass for anything. PLEASE DO SOMETHING. This isn’t just every so often. It is so frequent I cannot keep my sanity. PLEASE.
1:30 AM and they are still shooting off fireworks in dove springs and no cops.  I mean there is a fire house practically around the corner, how does no one come out and fine these assholes
Very large and growing homeless camp under bridge and along trail. Enforce the law!!

5 vehicles parked in handicap spaces by building 8. These lazy people do this all the time. Poor disabled people can never utilize their spots due to peoples laziness. Gate should be open, if not then people are in and out often. This is a constant issue and would be awesome if it was addressed. Building 8. Very small complex. Citizen House Blue Bluff. Take the little main apartment road all the w
The Ridgebacks are out off leash again. The owners phone number is 408-391-0979
Small dog in heat with access to no water
More trash dumped over night! Couch has been dumped over a month ago and people keep adding more and more to it everyday.

There are several street lights out on Cesar Chavez near the library. With so many people in the area, it is a huge concern and makes walking there at night feel very unsafe. I was only able to grab 2 light numbers. There are at least 8 lights out.

Political graffiti not city / state approved. Has racial slurs! 

Entire wall not approved by city with racial and derogatory terms.

Reoccurring issue; have submitted before. Traffic signal at N Lamar and Justin Ln is skipping the left turn green light. Multiple cycles only allowing green to go north-south on N Lamar. Not green to turn left (north) from Justin Ln. Causes backup of vehicles on Justin Ln
Giant pothole has been here for years despite numerous requests for repair
Construction crew has put up “no parking” signs without a permit

PLEASE REMOVE- Graffiti on our retail property- please remove. We’ve contacted the city multiple times about this issue. This was not sanctioned by us or the city of Austin!!!
Pursuant to the following:
Texas Penal Code § 28.08 (Graffiti) is the key state law that directly prohibits painting political messaging 
•  Texas Transportation Code Chapters 392 and 393

I do not understand how the bars get away with this. Idc if it’s first second or last Thursday. The music should not be heard AND felt 30 stories up. This is a residential area. Please hold these bars accountable!!!
SEND ENFORCEMENT!!!! We’re trying to sleep - DJ is way over DB limits

I found a dead bird on the sidewalk just at the.opposite of target, near UT Campus. I've put it on the bench and waiting here. Don't know what to do. A little sad. Tried feeding it water, it’s dead. A beautiful bird!
It is 1.15am and there is loud music . We live on E 8th and cannot sleep. I think the noise is coming from 6th, probably IFKYK. I am so sick of it. Please make it STOP !!

We are so sick of parking violations around our neighborhood with boats their trailers and their cars parking illegally and nothing happens. What do we need to do to get more enforcement out here to give tickets and tow cars because this is getting ridiculous and it’s so unfair to the neighborhood.
Homeless camps - multiple in this area. We’ve had personal property stolen and breaking in this area. Please help !! Relocate to Other ones homeless assistance
Non stop and it’s 1245am !!!!!!

So excited for the recent repairs to Dottie Jordan’s rotating platform, but two of the four anchors are jutting out with sharp corners. I worry about someone falling on it or running into it when it’s spinning. Will you please look into covering or removing these before someone gets hurt?

Unhoused encampment sprung up occupying bench & communal space of city park. LOTS of trash & household items spread out over the whole area. It’s unusable for the public and makes the park feel unsafe with everything they have dumped out there

Send the cops to deal with these Jack asses before someone else goes over there and deals with them and you really need the cops.  It’s after 11:30 on a work night and these criminal hack asses are still shooting off fireworks.  APD needs to come and do their d*** job

Bunch of people lighting fireworks in the street on hanmermill drive near the intersection of Hammermill and candle tree.  Causing a hazard in the road, disturbing the peace and generally being criminals light fireworks.  Please send officers and actually fine someone. God forbid APD do their job

Willow rooftop bar over bass limit. Also no one even there on roof making it more frustrating. (A problem most sundays). Please talk to them. I’ve reviewed their permit and measure the level from my balcony behind them. They violate regularly.

Sorry I didn’t realize I needed a picture or I would have taken one. 

In Bartholomew park there is a fenced football field in the middle that hasn’t had its grass cut for a long time. The rest of the park was recently cut but people use that un used football field to walk their dogs in the morning and it’s got high grass and weeds everywhere currently to the point where it’s unusable.

The city just repaved this street with chip seal and they did an awful job. Before the repaving, the road had multiple potholes but they didn’t patch nor fill them when repaving. Now the potholes are hidden and are a trip hazard. Honestly the worst repaving job I’ve ever seen. They didn’t fill the holes nor even sweep up old gravel that was filling them. The pavement is patchy and not applied even

Graffiti that was designed to look official, yet breaks state and local law. Please address this. 

Texas Penal Code § 28.08 (Graffiti) is the key state law that directly prohibits painting political messaging (or any markings) on public property like electrical boxes, retaining walls, utility structures, or similar tangible property without the owner’s effective consent.

When sitting at intersection to cross RM 620 from Great Valley, we have on at least four different occasions had to sit through that light more that two cycles without it turning green for that side only. Also the options below do not give the full picture of the issue. Needs to be reviewed. Thanks.

This morning on the Mabel Davis trail there was an unattended cooler full of beer left on the trail. On the top it was written “Patriot 5K”
I don’t think it is right to leave beer out on the trail. It is illegal.
Whoever did it should be contacted and stopped.

Vehicle blocking dumpster. As owner of the business at 1100 E 6th St know as OKO, I’m requesting the vehicle be towed. The vehicle has not moved in 24 hours and it is keeping our trash dumpster from being emptied. The dumpster is overflowing and full of days old food now.

Uber/Lyft/Waymo should be banned from pickup and drop off at this bus stop. They all stop for several minutes and it prevents the buses from accessing the bus stop. It’s an ADA issue as well. These companies should remove this block from their systems as  a drop off or pickup location.

Substantial and detailed graffiti on the side of the ramp entrance of 360 is appearing. It has been ongoing and it gets more detailed as days go by. Please take care of this before it becomes bigger. Thank you for your work.
items.address: 4058 S Capital of Texas Hwy SB, Austin

items.text: Commons ford EAST trail overgrown and dangerous (snakes). It IS on your maps and we go thru this every year .. it’s getting tedious. I’m sending this in from the car as there was no signal at CG east trail
Vines are growing up the oak tree and are starting to hang from the branches. Can you please cut these vines at the base? Located on the live oak trees in the tree planters between Pfluger bridge

There is a case of animal abuse in my apartment located at 12001 metric blvd Austin Tex 78758. There is a grey Pitbull who appears to have just had puppies and the owner is not feeding them. The dog is skin and bone. The apartment the dog is located in is 810. Their downstairs neighbor has told me she hears dogs barking and fighting all night long. I’m really worried the dog is not going to make i

This man in 3622 menchaca rd. Apartment 218 has been frequently harassing me and is also beating their dog. They threatened to have their off leash dog attack mine and me. Has made multiple false 311 reports about me tethering my dog outside. Also has publicly beat their dog. Im tired of the harassment

More Trash thrown into the wildflower site behind bus stop 3301 near Mabel Davis Park trailhead. I continually request a trash can from Cap Metro to no avail. I will keep reporting this litter until we get a trash can there. 
Morning July 1 2026

Abandoned Vehicle Parked Too Close to Stop Sign

Vehicle has not moved in months and often times has long metal poles sticking out of the bed of the truck. Location of vehicle and proximity to stop sign makes it difficult to make turn into the street

Completed. Caller mentions that nothing is working on the intersection for the pedestrians - the warning beacon doesn't display the right of way for pedestrians or the message to walk caller submitted previous request, but investigation mentioned everything was fine caller mentions it still being the same.
